description:
Advance the target.
  "in" — step into next call (blocks ~ms, returns {state, breakpoints, stack, frame0_locals})
  "over" — step over next call (same shape)
  "out" — run until current frame returns (same shape)
  "continue" — resume until next breakpoint (fire-and-forget; returns just {state, breakpoints} — poll debug_state for next stop)

include_stack.description: Include the new stack. Default true. Ignored for direction="continue".

include_vars.description: Include the new frame[0] locals. Default true. Ignored for direction="continue".

name: debug_step
